ops.title: fusekit: burn down the 41-issue lint backlog and add a golangci-lint CI job
ops.description: Found during the F0 CI restructure (2026-08-03): fusekit has never had a lint CI job — golangci-lint only ran via prek on changed files, so a 41-issue backlog accumulated invisibly (e.g. tenant/standard_planner.go:44 StandardPlanner.validate unused). The F0 lane shipped the lint job as go-vet-only with a TODO naming the count, because fixing Go source was out of F0's scope and landing a red job would have defeated the restructure. Separate lane, post-flag-day; pairs naturally with the F2-F6 migration sweep which will touch much of the same code.

ops.text: golangci-lint runs as a CI job on fusekit (ubuntu, GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64) and is green
The 41 pre-existing issues (31 unused, 7 errcheck, 3 staticcheck) are fixed or individually justified — no blanket excludes
